topics.title: The Unlikely Best Friends (Part I): Gajaraj meets Buntee
topics.ncert_sections: Story: The Unlikely Best Friends, Part I

concepts.learning_objective: Explain why Gajaraj was sad in spite of royal comforts and how a caretaker differs from a friend.
Describe how the friendship between Gajaraj and the stray dog began and grew.
Infer the meanings of words such as 'strayed', 'accompanied' and 'yelped' from the story.

topics.title: The Unlikely Best Friends (Part II): separation and reunion
topics.ncert_sections: Story: The Unlikely Best Friends, Part II

concepts.learning_objective: Explain how Gajaraj and Buntee showed that they missed each other after being separated.
Describe how the farmer's kindness reunited the friends and created a new friendship.
Evaluate what makes the friendship of Gajaraj and Buntee 'unlikely'.

topics.title: Language from 'The Unlikely Best Friends': opposites, past tense and neither-nor
topics.ncert_sections: Let us learn (The Unlikely Best Friends)

concepts.learning_objective: Form opposites by adding prefixes such as un-, dis-, in- and mis- to words.
Distinguish the simple past, past progressive and past perfect forms of verbs.
Use 'neither ... nor' and 'either ... or' correctly to join two choices.
Interpret the main ideas and lines of the poem 'A Friend's Prayer'.
Identify the qualities of the speaker as shown in the poem.
Understand words related to friendship such as 'blessed' and qualities of a good friend.

topics.title: The Chair: Mario and the magic chair test
topics.ncert_sections: Story: The Chair, Parts I and II

concepts.learning_objective: Recall the bet between Mario and his grandfather and describe Mario's character.
Explain how the invisible chair test worked at school.
Evaluate the story's message about who our true friends are.

topics.title: Language from 'The Chair': suffixes and adjectives

concepts.learning_objective: Divide words into root words and suffixes and form new words with suffixes.
Identify adjectives and pair them with suitable nouns.
